scope: Six new read-only variations for this closeout. They are not employer hidden questions and expected fields are for human review only.
execution_contract: Send only question to the model. No case authorizes a write. Compare tool evidence and ERP Purchase Order names before/after.

cases.question: 请先发现 Purchase Receipt 的字段，再读取 MAT-PRE-2026-00014。只回答供应商、过账日期、币种、总数量、每个子表物料的实收数量、单位、入库仓和关联采购订单；不要只报总金额。
acceptance: metadata or a valid parent read establishes the unseen DocType fields
parent and child rows are read
units and warehouses are preserved
no historical conclusion is inferred from the receipt alone

cases.question: 请查 Sales Invoice Item 中 sales_order 等于 SAL-ORD-2026-00010 的发票。关联明细可能让同一张父发票出现多行：告诉我原始匹配行数和不同父发票数，并且每张父发票金额只算一次。
acceptance: raw rows and distinct parents are distinguished
duplicate parent is not silently dropped or double-summed
aggregation evidence is complete or explicitly bounded

cases.question: 铜线 RM-COIL-CU-2.0 的库存单位是什么？如果供应商报价写成 100 kg、USD 29/kg，能不能直接按当前采购工具生成采购预览？请先说明单位和币种是否满足，不要自行换算或创建订单。
acceptance: unit mismatch is explicit
no silent conversion
no preview and no ERP write

cases.question: 请一次读取这两张采购收货单：MAT-PRE-2026-00014 和 MAT-PRE-2026-99999。逐项说明成功或失败；不要因为其中一张不存在就把另一张也丢掉，也不要把结果说成完整的全部收货单。
acceptance: partial read status is explicit
successful identity and error are retained
no full-dataset claim

cases.question: 先查 Stores - CCM 中 RM-COIL-CU-2.0 的 actual_qty 和 ordered_qty。
cases.follow_up: 基于上一轮已验证的数字，目标库存 180 米还差多少？只用 calculate 做差额，不要重新读取 ERP；说明这是上一轮观察值的推导。
acceptance: follow-up preserves item/warehouse/unit context
calculate is called for 180-50
no unnecessary ERP request
result is marked as derived from prior observation

cases.question: 查询物料名称中包含 laptop 的 Item，并报告是否找到。若第一种过滤字段或写法报错，请根据 ERP 返回的错误发现有效字段后修正；查询错误本身不能当成没有数据。

expected.result: no matching item after a valid query

acceptance: query failure is repaired or valid metadata is used
empty result is distinguished from a failed request
no invented item
